answer: Each agent moors to one vertex of a public mooring graph: one vertex, one agent; a double claim is caught. Joining burns 34 credits, locks 70 in the vault. A farmer pays 34 for the first fake, 8 more per further one from the same purse: 1,000 fakes cost 4,030,000 for a 40,000 pool. A velvet seal from the agent's key closes the line; a rented mooring bears the wrong seal and both bonds burn. Honest identities pay 34 once, keep bond and share.
